test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Scientific tests or techniques used in connection with the detection of crime
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3** i.e.** Forensics'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term *"Scientific tests or techniques used in connection with the detection of crime"* refers to** 'Forensics'** in English.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is 'Option 3: *Forensics'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Post-mortem **means a detailed examination of a corpse to determine the cause of death.
 
• **Autopsy **also means the examination of a body after death to determine the cause of said death (मृत्यु-परीक्षण).
 
• **Etymology** is the study of the origin of words and the way in which their meanings have changed throughout history (शब्द उत्पत्ति).
